                                          codes: 0=success, 2=usage error,      
                                          4=network/auth, 5=internal            
    diff <before> <after>                 Compare two ModelSnapshot JSON files  
                                          and show differences                  
    view                                  Start a local viewer for a            
                                          ModelSnapshot                         
    telemetry                             Manage anonymous usage telemetry

DESCRIPTION:
Validate a ModelSnapshot against rules

USAGE:
    fcon validate [model-snapshot] [rules-dir] [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    [model-snapshot]    Path to ModelSnapshot JSON (default:                    
                        .flowconsole/snapshots/latest.json). Use '-' for stdin  
    [rules-dir]         Path to rules directory (default: from .flowconsole.yaml
                        rules_dir or ./rules/)                                  

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                Prints help information                           
        --config <PATH>       Path to .flowconsole.yaml config file (default:   
                              auto-discovered)                                  
        --verbose             Debug logging to stderr                           
        --no-color            Disable ANSI colors                               
        --no-telemetry        Disable telemetry for this invocation             
        --format <FORMAT>     Output format: human, json, sarif, junit (default:
                              human)                                            
        --severity <LEVEL>    Filter findings by minimum severity: info,        
                              warning, error, critical                          
        --fail-on <LEVEL>     Exit 1 if findings at this severity or above:     
                              info, warning, error (default: error)             
    -o, --output <PATH>       Write output to file instead of stdout            
        --target <TARGET>     Rule target filter: model, actual, diff           
        --watch               Watch mode: re-run on file change (incompatible   
                              with stdin '-')                                   
        --include-trace       Include expression and bindings trace in findings 
                              output

DESCRIPTION:
Push data to FlowConsole backend. Secrets only via FLOWCONSOLE_API_KEY env; 
--api-key flag refused. Exit codes: 0=success, 2=usage error, 4=network/auth, 
5=internal

USAGE:
    fcon push [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help    Prints help information

COMMANDS:
    snapshot <snapshot>    Push a ModelSnapshot to the FlowConsole backend.     
                           Per-source split: mixed-source snapshots are         
                           automatically split by source field and pushed as    
                           separate partitions. Auth via FLOWCONSOLE_API_KEY env
                           (PAT or JWT). Retries with exponential backoff (3    
                           attempts); circuit breaker on 3 consecutive 5xx      
    findings <findings>    Push validation findings to the FlowConsole backend

                             keys leak into CI logs)
